plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked altitude-vs-pressure chart from Florin Périer's 19 September 1648 Puy-de-Dôme climb shows mercury falling from 711 mm (26 pouces 3.5 lignes) at the Clermont Minims monastery garden (~395 m elevation) to 627 mm (23 pouces 2 lignes) at the Puy-de-Dôme summit (1,465 m, a drop of 84 mm / 3 pouces 1.5 lignes across ~1,000 m of altitude).
